items.description: filing a valid stock record (sku, location, non-negative quantity, inventory_code) for a fresh pair persists it and shows a confirmation
retrieving a previously filed (sku, location) pair returns the stored sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code exactly as filed
inserting a stock_records row missing one of sku, location, quantity, or inventory_code raises a NOT NULL IntegrityError against the branch DB (verifies the migration realized PI2)
the app/routes boundary module does not import the DB session or ORM models; persistence code lives only in StockRepository (layering contract)
submitting a filing with a negative quantity is rejected with an inline error that names the quantity field, and no negative row is stored
inserting a stock_records row with quantity < 0 directly raises a CHECK-constraint violation against the branch DB (verifies the migration realized PI3)
refiling the same (sku, location) pair with a different quantity resolves to exactly one row holding the new quantity; no duplicate row is stored
inserting two stock_records rows with the same (sku, location) pair directly raises a unique-constraint IntegrityError against the branch DB (verifies the migration realized PI1)
refiling an existing (sku, location) pair returns a confirmation of the filed record and never an error page
the DB connection resolves from the injected DATABASE_URL env var (databricks_postgres on the paired branch); no hardcoded DSN or app-specific DB name (config-in-env)
the file-stock API boundary returns a JSON response, not server-rendered HTML, for the filing confirmation (SPA JSON boundary contract)

the Alembic migration creating stock_records applies and single-step-reverses cleanly (downgrade -1, upgrade head, @pytest.mark.migration on an isolated branch), preserving pre-existing seeded rows (verifies PI4)
opening the home stock-by-location table lists each filed record as a row showing its SKU, its location, and its quantity
viewing a location with no filed stock records shows the explicit "No stock at this location" message instead of a blank page
a single SKU filed at two different locations appears in the table as two distinct rows, each showing its own location and its own quantity
the quantity column's cells carry the design-guide right-align class/data-testid seam and render right-aligned (client component/Playwright harness)
the stock-table read boundary (app/routes) does not import the DB session or ORM models; read persistence is only in StockRepository (layering contract for the read path)
